newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT mulls 100 bln yen euroyen bond - sources.
newsitem.headline: NTT mulls 100 bln yen euroyen bond - sources.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) will soon set terms for a 10-year euroyen bond issue which could total up to 100 billion yen, underwriting sources said on Tuesday.

"NTT is making final arrangements with lead-managers on its planned issue of euroyen bonds. The amount of the bond will be based on investor demand and market conditions, but it is expected to be a maximum of 100 billion yen," one underwriter, who declined to be named, told Reuters.
The underwriting sources said the money raised from the bond issue would be used for capital investment.

Last week, joint lead-manager Morgan Stanley International said in London that the Japanese telecommunications giant plans to issue a sizable 10-year Euroyen bond in the near future. Merrill Lynch will be the other joint lead manager.
An NTT official said that the company was considering issuing euroyen bonds, but did not give further details.
